title: Separate staff and public accounts
summary: Staff, volunteer, student and admin accounts are now for APES work only. Anyone who wants to use APES services for themselves uses a separate public account with a personal email address.
changes: Staff-side accounts can no longer raise their own tickets, add pets, open APES CIC cases or apply for roles. They see a page explaining how to use a personal public account instead.
Staff can still open Shelter and Rescue cases and Pet Care Clinic consultations for a client's pet.
Public registration and email changes refuse APES work email addresses and ask for a personal email.
Cloudron sign-in can no longer turn a public account into a staff account.

A new admin command finds personal records held by staff-side accounts, shows a report first, and after confirmation archives them and emails the people affected. Nothing is deleted, and a second command restores them.
The Help page explains why staff need a separate personal account, including the conflict-of-interest rule, and affected staff see a one-off notice they can dismiss.
version_rationale: Minor: adds a staff ability for working on a client's behalf, an archive and restore command, a guidance page and a help section, with additive database changes only.
validation: New feature tests for the ability split, the guidance page, registration and email change, Cloudron sign-in, the archive and restore commands, the help section and the notice.
Upgrade test confirming the migration removes the old staff grants and keeps staff work abilities.
Browser check of the guidance page and the Help page.
known_limitations: Existing personal records on staff accounts stay in place until an administrator runs the archive command after this release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new columns are nullable and can stay; staff role grants return when the previous release re-syncs permissions.
provenance: Milestone v0.54.0 Beta: Separate staff and public accounts, epic #510 with issues #511 to #516, shipped in pull request #660.
